note: Swap the 3rd and 4th letters from the right of any code to highlight the exit and item. The swap keeps the checksum (values 16-18 change by +d, 0, -d, d = the difference of the two letters) but changes two fields: reveal ($94) by d and wall pass ($76) by -d. So it works whenever the two letters differ, and it can also switch wall pass on or off; with two equal letters nothing changes.
